---
title: "Assignment"
subtitle: "Informatica Feminale Summer School (1 Credit Point)"
---

It is possible to obtain a Credit Point by handing in a mini project.
It is mandatory to schedule a meeting with the instructor beforehand.
Choose one of the two options below.

## Option 1: Scrape your own data

Scrape your own data on Wikipedia and preprocess it accordingly.
Justify why you chose exactly this data. Hence, some relevancy argument must be given. Ideally, discuss potential
research questions and methods that can be used with your data.

## Option 2: Use the provided revision data set

Use the revision data set, which contains all revisions from the
"Britney Spears" Wikipedia article. Think about a possible research
question (ideally a social scientific one) and answer it with an appropriate method. Discuss why you
chose that method and interpret the results.

## What to hand in

- A documented R script (`.R` or `.Rmd`)
- A short PDF (1–3 pages) describing the data and outlining what you
  did and why (Times New Roman, 12pt, 1.5 line spacing, page numbers,
  and a consistent citation style)

Please send the PDF via email by 30.09.26 (your local time zone).
